title: The week in pictures: ICE In Minnesota, tractors in Paris and Trump gets a second-hand Nobel
summary: Iran's protests go international amid a deadly crackdown, ICE agents terrorise US citizens in Minnesota, far-right leader Marine Le Pen appeals her embezzlement conviction, French farmers protest with tractors in Paris and US President Donald Trump gets his long-coveted Nobel Prize – albeit second-hand. FRANCE 24 looks back at the week's most striking image…
